verdict.rationale: Cactus documents 2-bit model exports through its paid platform (docs-3), and a community benchmark ran a fine-tuned Needle 3 in a W4A8 quantized form (comm-10), so very-low-bit and 4-bit integer quantization are evidenced. Nothing documents a selectable range up to 8-bit weights or quantifies the memory savings. Missing for 10: documented range of quantization formats (e.g., INT8/3-bit weight options), user-facing controls for choosing precision locally, memory-footprint figures, first-party docs on quantization depth.
